purpose: Generated customer-safe SupportFlow knowledge graph projection for article-first retrieval. This static graph intentionally excludes internal repository module and submodule metadata.
sourceOfTruth: Article configs and generated article references
runtimePolicy: No graph database, vector database, Python stack, local embedding model, or Obsidian runtime is required by the customer plugin.
The graph improves article-first retrieval and evidence tracing; final answers must still be grounded in selected article content and guide/action evidence.
Internal repository module-impact relations are maintainer-only and are not shipped in the customer plugin.
Generated graph files must not be hand-edited.
